input.content:
# Tooltip with the task title on hover

## Context
Hovering over a task should show its full title in a native tooltip (useful when a long title is hard to read).

**Size: Trivial** (one line in one file, no new behaviour beyond a browser-native attribute) → per CLAUDE.md, no committed plan in `plan/`.

## Change
`app/app.js:46`, in `render()`, right after the title is set via `textContent`:

```js
const span = li.querySelector('span');
span.textContent = t.title;
span.title = t.title;
```

- Uses the DOM `title` property (an attribute, never parsed as HTML), so it stays within `policy-security#S3`.
- No CSS or HTML changes; no new UI text, so no Vietnamese wording to approve.

## Proof
Add one test to `tests/app.test.js`: keep the elements made by `createElement` in `loadApp()` (and return them), submit `'Mua sữa'`, then assert the rendered `li`'s `span` has `textContent === 'Mua sữa'` and `title === 'Mua sữa'`.

## Verification
- `node --test`: all tests pass.
- `python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`, add a task, hover over its text and check that the tooltip shows the title.
- I'll leave the change uncommitted for a person to review and commit.
